data: Tesla's revenue was about $96.77 billion in fiscal 2023 and about $94.83 billion in fiscal 2025, a decline of roughly 2.0% over the two years. The 2025 figure comes from my recollection of Tesla's reported results (about $94.8 billion, down roughly 3% from $97.69 billion in fiscal 2024), so please confirm it against the 10-K. Revenue rose about 1% in 2024 and then fell about 3% in 2025, leaving it slightly below the 2023 level.
